# dispatch.

> dispatch. is an independent marketing agency for franchise and multi-location brands, based in Detroit, Michigan. It brings creative, strategy and performance together to help brands grow nationally and win locally.

dispatch. is a marketing agency. It is not dispatch, scheduling or field-service software.

- Founded: November 5, 2026, in Detroit, Michigan
- Founder: Mitchell Mills, a marketing expert with more than 10 years of experience working with franchise and multi-location brands
- Contact: mitch@dispatchco.io
- Website: https://dispatchco.io/

## Who dispatch. helps

- Franchisors and corporate teams: a marketing program the whole network can run on, with on-brand creative, clear budgets and reporting by location.
- Franchisees: local marketing that brings in customers, backed by the brand.
- Multi-location businesses: consistent marketing in every market, adjusted for markets that behave differently.

## Services

- Paid Media: search, social and local ads, with budgets that follow what's working.
- Creative Development: ads, landing pages and assets built to be tested and refreshed.
- Local Marketing Strategy: a plan for each market, rooted in the brand and shaped by local competition and demand.
- Campaign Management: launches, budget changes and updates on a set rhythm across every location.
- Measurement & Reporting: clear numbers by location and by program.

## Free marketing audit

A no-cost, location-by-location review covering campaign setup, creative, local search presence, and reporting, with a short list of recommended changes.
